claim: The composer works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; load once; activate service worker; set context offline; reload

claim: A teacher downloads one standalone HTML packet and a learner downloads a readable text response.
sandbox: starter lesson; download HTML; open its contents in a fresh page; complete controls; assert text response contents and no external URL

claim: The sample lesson is free to try without an account.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1; assert populated composer and no sign-in, payment, or card request

claim: Lesson content stays on the device and demo changes never touch the real draft.
where: landing first screen, composer, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh context; capture every request; edit demo; assert same-origin requests only, demo-prefixed storage, and untouched real draft key

claim: Learners can print the standalone packet.
where: learner packet Print packet action, README
sandbox: download the starter packet; open it in a fresh page; replace window.print with an observable spy; activate Print packet

claim: Teachers can download and re-import an editable JSON template.
sandbox: demo entry point; download template; change its title; import through the visible control; assert checked content appears

claim: When a teacher enables it, learner progress is saved only in that learner's browser and can be cleared.
where: composer toggle, learner packet, privacy, README
sandbox: demo entry; enable local save; download packet; serve on local test origin; enter progress; reload; assert restore; clear and assert removal
